GAP_AC_AMENDMENT: Canonical ID stdout invariant independent of display_mode.
Additional AC: ticket-create.sh stdout last line must ALWAYS be the canonical 16-hex ID regardless of ticket.display_mode config setting. display_mode affects format_ticket_id() rendering only — it must never alter the create stdout contract. After making the | tail -1 changes, add a verification test: with ticket.display_mode=alias set in config, run ticket create and assert | tail -1 returns 16-hex canonical form (not the alias).
